description: This Java class defines a command named RetrievePolicyEntries used within a policy management system. It includes methods to instantiate the command with a policy ID, deserialize from JSON, and manage command-specific data such as resource paths and payloads. The class extends AbstractCommand and implements PolicyQueryCommand, indicating it participates in a command-query pattern related to policies.
